name: Frostdraw Obelisk
desc:
The Frostdraw Obelisk is an NPC located within a secret area behind a destructible bookshelf on the second floor of the [Crypt of the Unbroken](location:crypt_of_the_unbroken), known as the [Glacial Remnant](location:glacial_remnant). It must be located and interacted with, along with [4 other element-based obelisks](entity:saintsworn_obelisks), to obtain the Saintsworn Oath.

It can only be interacted with if you have at least 15 Frostdraw. When interacted with, Faust, the Hero of Frost, will speak to the player.
